purpose: Reference player teams for the issue #84 trainer blocker census.
These are MEASUREMENT FIXTURES, not gameplay recommendations: they exist so the census
has a fixed, committed attacker and defender whose properties are stable and explainable.
They are small on purpose so every reported number can be traced back to a matchup a human
can read. Each team's lead ability is deliberately a category-neutral pinch ability
(Overgrow / Blaze) that is provably INACTIVE at the census baseline's full HP, so the
census attributes an ability blocker to the trainer Pokemon being measured rather than to
the fixture. Every move is a pinned ordinary fixed-base-power move, so move-mechanics
blockers reported by the census belong to the trainer data, not to the fixture.

notes: Physical-leaning fixture: every move is PHYSICAL, so this team exercises the
attacker-side physical category and the defender-side category-conditional ability rules.
Four move types (Normal, Grass, Normal, Steel) so both directions see varied type matchups.
No held item: an omitted item is the pinned ITEM_NONE, not an unknown.
Special-leaning fixture: three SPECIAL moves plus one PHYSICAL, so the census covers the
special category in both directions without needing a third team.
Holds Wise Glasses, the one H&S held item the production calculator already models, so the
fixture also proves a modelled item contributes no blocker on either side.
